heading: INT. TOWER OF THE LAST STAIR - NIGHT

units.text: INT. TOWER OF THE LAST STAIR - NIGHT
A circular stone chamber at the top of a thousand steps.
A cracked crystal on a pedestal pulses faintly.
Rain lashes the narrow windows.
ALDRIC, 40s, a battered knight in dented plate, leans on his sword.
THESSALY, 30s, a sorceress in midnight blue, traces runes in the dust with a fingertip.
GORM, 50s, a heavy-set dwarf with a braided beard, sits on the top stair, catching his breath.
MIRREN, 18, a thief in a patched green cloak, circles the pedestal and eyes the crystal.
Thessaly, how long before the seal gives?
units.name: ALDRIC

units.text: Before dawn, if I'm right. Before midnight, if I'm wrong.
units.name: THESSALY

units.text: What do you think the odds are, Mirren?
units.name: GORM

units.text: Don't ask me. I'm the one who stole the map.
units.name: MIRREN

units.text: We've all stolen something, little one.
units.name: ALDRIC

units.text: Mirren, step back from the crystal.
units.name: THESSALY

units.text: I'm only looking.
units.name: MIRREN

units.text: Looking is how it begins.
units.name: THESSALY

units.text: Thessaly's right. My grandfather looked at a gem like that once. Went blind in one eye. Then the other.
units.name: GORM

units.text: Gorm, your grandfather went blind from drinking.
units.name: MIRREN

units.text: That too.
units.name: GORM

units.text: Enough. We climbed a thousand stairs for this. We say what we came to say.
units.name: ALDRIC

units.text: What did we come to say, Aldric?
units.name: THESSALY

units.text: That we will not let the King's witch-hunters have it.
units.name: ALDRIC

units.text: We'd have been better off smashing it and going home.
units.name: GORM

units.text: Smash it and the city drowns.
units.name: THESSALY

units.text: You never told me that.
units.name: MIRREN

units.text: You never asked, Mirren.
units.name: THESSALY

units.text: I did not tell either of you because I did not want you to leave.
units.name: ALDRIC

units.text: Then you're a fool, knight. Or a liar.
units.name: GORM

units.text: Perhaps both.
units.name: ALDRIC

units.text: Then why are we fighting over it?
units.name: MIRREN

units.text: We're not.
units.name: THESSALY

units.text: Speak for yourself.
units.name: GORM

units.text: Gorm. Put down your axe.
units.name: ALDRIC

units.text: I didn't pick it up.
units.name: GORM

units.text: You did. It's in your hand.
units.name: MIRREN

units.text: Gorm looks down.
The axe is there.
His hand is trembling.
The crystal pulses brighter.
It's speaking to you. To all of us. Close your ears.
units.name: THESSALY

units.text: I hear it. It says Aldric lied.
units.name: GORM

units.text: Gorm--
units.name: ALDRIC

units.text: The crystal flares.
The windows blow in on a wave of white light.
